title: Not the most comfortable
text: Not the most comfortable. Cute pop of color, easy to assemble. I got this to work from home, after a couple of hours it gets uncomfortable. Would recommend this if you don’t spend 8 hours at your desk.

product_metadata.title: Flash Furniture Clayton Mid-Back Purple Quilted Vinyl Swivel Task Office Chair with Arms
features: Whether you're updating your office chair, the desk chair in your dorm room, or your home office seating this computer chair offers all the style you need
[_Our chair conforms to ANSI/BIFMA standard X5.1-17_] ELEGANT AESTHETIC: Purple vinyl upholstery and mid-back design with CAL 117 fire retardant foam padding and a waterfall front seat edge
EFFORTLESS MOBILITY: 360° Swivel seat with pneumatic seat height adjustment; 5 star nylon base with dual wheel casters
MULTI-USE CHAIR: Modern style adjustable chair for home and office use
PRODUCT MEASUREMENTS: Overall Size: 23"W x 24"D x 34-38.75"H; Seat Size: 16.5"W x 16.5"D x 16.75-21.75"H; Back Size: 16.5"W x 19"H; Arm Size: 23.5-28.5"H from floor; 7.5"H from seat
description: Give your workspace a different look with this elegant computer task chair with arms that features quilted, tufted upholstery. Armchairs lend an upscale, designer feel to the conference or board room as well as your home office. The streamlined silhouette allows more room for members and guests while the T-shape arms relieve pressure from the neck and shoulders to get you comfortably through long workdays. The versatile, on-trend look of this chair enables it to function in multiple capacities in the office from the receptionist's desk to the conference room as well as your home office. A mid-back design offers support to the mid-to-upper back region and is ideal for anyone who does a great deal of typing throughout the day. Upholstered in supple vinyl with biscuit tufting and generously padded with 2 inches of CAL 117 fire retardant foam, this swivel task chair will cradle you in comfort. The waterfall front seat edge removes pressure from the lower legs and improves circulation. A pneumatic seat height adjustment lever allows for a custom seating experience for staff and guests alike. This sturdy swivel task chair has a heavy-duty base with dual wheel casters and a 360 degree swivel seat that make it easy to reach multiple work surfaces without strain. Whether you're greeting visitors, hosting out of town clients, or joining an online meeting in your home office this mid-back swivel task chair is a great choice to show your sophisticated style.
